server.name: community-stashpad
server.note_container: the store is written under the working directory, at {root}/.stashpad, so the mount is enough and HOME does not need moving
server.note: the only server in the sample whose write tool takes a caller-supplied id, so a repeat has a key to collapse onto.
server.note_ignore: Its append-only logs (audit.jsonl, feedback.jsonl) stamp every line with a wall clock time to the millisecond, so they cannot be compared by content. The filesystem part therefore excludes them and an append-log part counts their lines instead, dropping only the declared key `at`. That recovers the one thing a duplicate changes in a log: how many lines it has. Handoff files stay excluded outright, because their names carry a timestamp and a random suffix, so neither a digest nor a line count can compare them.
